method: Probability of Backtest Overfitting — CSCV (Bailey/López de Prado, 2014)
interpretation: Headline — PER-TICKER timing PBO (median across names) = 0.5176. With the stock held fixed so only the divination timing rule varies, selecting the in-sample-best timing rule lands below the OOS median ~52% of the time — the ≈0.5 coin-flip that confirms no persistent timing skill. The POOLED cross-name PBO looks lower (raw 0.3754, excess 0.1844) only because picking the name that won (e.g. NVDA) persists across the whole bull — that is selection/momentum, not skill, and is exactly the confound per-ticker PBO removes.
